trial_title: Diagnostic Utility of MRI in Female Patients With Nipple Discharge: A Prospective Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of the proposed prospective study is to determine the diagnostic value of MRI for the evaluation of patients with pathologic nipple discharge. Breast surgeons will identify clinic patients with pathologic nipple discharge (unilateral and bloody or unilateral and clear) and refer them for breast MRI.
